source_review: Only the four registered CLI source paths changed. The frozen StartGoalResult is validated before the shared context adopts a Session. The Goal, Session, project, protocol, revision, status and writer identities are checked, while Goal revision remains separate from Session CAS.

A project-level goal.start sends null session, revision and epoch; an existing Session first reads session.get to refresh its writer CAS and event cursor. Pending replies replay the original envelope unchanged, and a pre-admission interrupt prevents the first Goal write.

A draft reports establishment with execution NOT_STARTED and no acceptance claim. A non-draft Goal follows its one canonical Task, eventual Run, event pages, report and artifacts; blocked or incomplete evidence does not exit zero. Cancellation after admission targets the original Run and requires host-confirmed settlement for exit 130.
The Goal result is the sole source of a newly adopted Session. The CLI does not create a synthetic session, Task, Run or Goal, and does not emit session.send as a substitute for goal.start.
